# Coframe

> Coframe is a fully managed conversion rate optimization service that generates and tests website variations using AI, delivering 10x more experiments than traditional CRO agencies at a fraction of the cost. Partnered with OpenAI, Coframe owns the outcome end-to-end, deploying tests within hours instead of weeks.

## Key Benefits
- **10x More Tests**: Generate 10x the number of experiments compared to traditional CRO agencies
- **Fraction of the Cost**: Get enterprise-level optimization for a fraction of agency pricing
- **Full Ownership**: We own the outcome end-to-end, from ideation through deployment
- **Hours Not Weeks**: Deploy ideas and tests within hours instead of weeks
- **Enterprise Ready**: SOC 2 certified with AI protection and automatic fallbacks

## How It Works
- [Analyze Your Site](https://app.coframe.com/start): Coframe learns your site, audience, and goals to surface opportunities
- [Approve Variations](https://coframe.com/#how-it-works): Review AI-generated copy, code, and visuals before they go live
- [Track Results](https://coframe.com/#impact): Monitor lift and revenue impact with real-time analytics

## Platform Capabilities
- [UI Code Generation](https://app.coframe.com/start): Generate deployable components, layouts, and experiments
- [Copy Optimization](https://app.coframe.com/start): Performance-driven headlines, CTAs, and full-page content
- [Ad-to-Page Optimization](https://coframe.com/post/ad-to-landing-page-optimization): Convert ads into landing page experiments
- [Segmentation & Personalization](https://coframe.com/post/segmentation-personalization): Optimize for every audience segment
